name: absensi
description: Aplikasi absensi — monorepo (web, worker, database, permissions)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @absensi/permissions && npm run build --workspace @absensi/database && npm run build --workspace @absensi/auth
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @absensi/worker && npm run build --workspace @absensi/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @absensi/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @absensi/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @absensi/auth && npm run typecheck --workspace @absensi/database && npm run typecheck --workspace @absensi/permissions
scripts.test:run: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
